translations.web: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before Yahweh, before the veil.
translations.bsb: and he is to dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD in front of the veil.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, even before the vail.
translations.asv: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before Jehovah, before the veil.
